name: USDA FoodData Central
tagline: Official US government food composition and nutrient data API
description: USDA FoodData Central provides comprehensive food composition data including nutrients, portions, and branded products. Free API with key-based access for developers building nutrition apps, food databases, and dietary analysis tools.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter or X-Api-Key header; free self-serve signup

rate_limits: 1,000 requests per hour per API key
use_cases: search foods by name and get nutrient profiles
look up detailed nutrition facts by FDC ID
build meal planners with official USDA nutrient data
validate food composition for dietary apps
